title: "Extract information from behavioral and physiological files and combine it into a single file for the analysis. December 2020"
output: pdf_document
---


Clean the environment 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

```

Add libraries
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(plyr) # to combine multiple data frames (rbind.fill command)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) # to extract numeric values from a string (here: file names)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr) #for transforming from wide to long data
library(cowplot)
library(ggsignif)
library(plotrix) #for calculating standard errors 
library(lattice) # to make xy plots
library(lme4)#for mixed models
library(parallel) #for parallel processing
library(afex) #for mixed function
library(car) #for scatterplot command
library(devtools) # for histograms
library(ez) #for repeated measures ANOVA
library(DataCombine) # for slide function to lag variables
library(gridExtra)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr) #for ddply function
library(ez) #for repeated measures ANOVA
library(haven) #for write_sav function
```

Extract individual contributions from each participant and save it as csv file - with all trials 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

getwd()
setwd("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv")
path <- "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv/"

out.file<-""
file.names <- dir(path, pattern =".csv")
N <- 0 #subject number

for(i in 1:length(file.names)){
  file <- read.table(file.names[i],header=TRUE, sep=";", stringsAsFactors=FALSE) #should be "i" instead of 1
  print(file.names[i])
  print(i)


  # load data for public goods game
  wb <- read.csv(file = file.names[i],sep=";")#[,224:1207]#should be "i" instead of 1 

  ## extract the order of conditions 
  sequence <- wb[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( wb ) ) ] 
  cols <- data.frame(colnames(sequence))
  cols_sep <- cols %>% separate(colnames.sequence., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  sequence_task <- unique(cols_sep$cond)
  sequence_task <- as.data.frame(sequence_task)
  sequence_task$order <- c(1:nrow(sequence_task))

  ## extract individual contributions to the public pools 
  #safe condition
  safe <- wb[ , grepl( "pgg_safe", names( wb ) ) ] 
  safe <- safe[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( safe ) ) ] 
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(safe))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.safe., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  # order of the trials, in order to know which condition was presented first 
  safe_order <- unique(columns_sep$cond)

  # safe block 1
  safe_1 <- wb[ , grepl( safe_order[1] , names( wb ) ) ] #find columns for safe condition block 1
  safe1_trials <- as.data.frame(safe_1[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( safe_1 ) )]) #extract total contributions to the pool for each round 
  safe1_activecontr <- as.data.frame(safe_1[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names( safe_1 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed to the pool
  #transpose 
  safe_1 <- t(safe1_trials)
  safe_activecontr1 <- t(safe1_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(safe_1) = NULL
  dimnames(safe_activecontr1) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  safe_1 <- as.data.frame(safe_1)
  names(safe_1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(safe_1))
  block_nr = 1
  
  safe_activecontr1 <- as.data.frame(safe_activecontr1)
  names(safe_activecontr1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(safe_1))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(safe_1))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == safe_order[1]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(safe_1))

  safe_1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, safe_1)
  safe_activecontr1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, safe_activecontr1)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  safe1_r <- reshape(data=safe_1, 
                 idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                 varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                 timevar = "subj_group",
                 v.names = "contr",
                 times = c("1","2","3"), 
                 direction = "long")
  
  safe_activecontr1_r <- reshape(data=safe_activecontr1, 
               idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
               varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
               timevar = "subj_group",
               v.names = "active_contr",
               times = c("1","2","3"), 
               direction = "long")
  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  safe1_final <- merge(safe1_r,safe_activecontr1_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  condition <- 'safe'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(safe_1)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(safe_1)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(safe_1)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow(safe1_final))
  safe1_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond,safe1_final)
  
  
  
  #safe block2
  safe_2 <- wb[ , grepl( safe_order[2] , names( wb ) ) ]
  safe2_trials <- as.data.frame(safe_2[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( safe_2 ) )])
  safe2_activecontr <- as.data.frame(safe_2[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names( safe_2 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed to the pool
  
  #transpose 
  safe_2 <- t(safe2_trials)
  safe_activecontr2 <- t(safe2_activecontr)
  dimnames(safe_2) = NULL
  dimnames(safe_activecontr2) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  safe_2 <- as.data.frame(safe_2)
  names(safe_2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  safe_activecontr2 <- as.data.frame(safe_activecontr2)
  names(safe_activecontr2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(safe_2))
  block_nr = 2
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(safe_2))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(safe_2))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == safe_order[2]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(safe_2))
  
  safe_2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, safe_2)
  safe_activecontr2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, safe_activecontr2)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  safe2_r <- reshape(data=safe_2, 
                     idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                     varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                     timevar = "subj_group",
                     v.names = "contr",
                     times = c("1","2","3"), 
                     direction = "long")
  
  safe_activecontr2_r <- reshape(data=safe_activecontr2, 
             idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
             varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
             timevar = "subj_group",
             v.names = "active_contr",
             times = c("1","2","3"), 
             direction = "long")
  

  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  safe2_final <- merge(safe2_r,safe_activecontr2_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  condition <- 'safe'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(safe_2)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(safe_2)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(safe_2)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow(safe2_final))
  safe2_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond,safe2_final)
  

  
  ## mild condition
  mild <- wb[ , grepl( "pgg_mild", names( wb ) ) ] 
  mild <- mild[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( mild ) ) ] 
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(mild))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.mild., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  mild_order <- unique(columns_sep$cond)
  
  
  #mild block 1 
  mild_1 <- wb[ , grepl( mild_order[1] , names( wb ) ) ]
  mild1_trials <- as.data.frame(mild_1[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( mild_1 ) )])
  mild1_activecontr <- as.data.frame(mild_1[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names( mild_1 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed to the pool
  mildstim1_trials <- as.data.frame(mild_1[ , grepl( "is_mildstim_trial" , names( mild_1 ) )])
  # number of trials with shocks within each condition blocks
  rm_mild1 <- as.vector(which(apply(mildstim1_trials, 2, function(x) any(grepl(1, x)))))# columns with data to be removed because of the shock receipt
  
  
  #transpose 
  mild_1 <- t(mild1_trials)
  mild_activecontr1 <- t(mild1_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(mild_1) = NULL
  dimnames(mild_activecontr1) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  mild_1 <- as.data.frame(mild_1)
  names(mild_1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  mild_activecontr1 <- as.data.frame(mild_activecontr1)
  names(mild_activecontr1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(mild_1))
  block_nr = 1
 
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(mild_1))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(mild_1))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == mild_order[1]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(mild_1))

  mild_1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, mild_1)
  mild_activecontr1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, mild_activecontr1)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  mild1_r <- reshape(data=mild_1, 
                     idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                     varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                     timevar = "subj_group",
                     v.names = "contr",
                     times = c("1","2","3"), 
                     direction = "long")
  
  
  
  mild_activecontr1_r <- reshape(data=mild_activecontr1, 
               idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
               varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
               timevar = "subj_group",
               v.names = "active_contr",
               times = c("1","2","3"), 
               direction = "long")
  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  mild1_final <- merge(mild1_r,mild_activecontr1_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  
  condition <- 'mild'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(mild_1)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(mild_1)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(mild_1)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow(mild1_final))
  mild1_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond,mild1_final)
  
  
  
  #mild block2 
  mild_2 <- wb[ , grepl(mild_order[2] , names( wb ) ) ]
  mild2_trials <- as.data.frame(mild_2[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( mild_2 ) )])
  mildstim2_trials <- as.data.frame(mild_2[ , grepl( "is_mildstim_trial" , names( mild_2 ) )])
  mild2_activecontr <- as.data.frame(mild_2[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names( mild_2 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed to the pool
  # number of trials with shocks within each condition blocks
  rm_mild2 <- as.vector(which(apply(mildstim2_trials, 2, function(x) any(grepl(1, x)))))# columns with data to be removed because of the shock receipt
  
  
  #transpose 
  mild_2 <- t(mild2_trials)
  mild_activecontr2 <- t(mild2_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(mild_2) = NULL
  dimnames(mild_activecontr2) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  mild_2 <- as.data.frame(mild_2)
  names(mild_2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  mild_activecontr2 <- as.data.frame(mild_activecontr2)
  names(mild_activecontr2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(mild_2))
  block_nr = 2
  
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(mild_2))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(mild_2))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == mild_order[2]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(mild_2))
  
  
  
  mild_2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, mild_2)
  mild_activecontr2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, mild_activecontr2)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  mild2_r <- reshape(data=mild_2, 
                     idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                     varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                     timevar = "subj_group",
                     v.names = "contr",
                     times = c("1","2","3"), 
                     direction = "long")
  
  mild_activecontr2_r <- reshape(data=mild_activecontr2, 
             idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
             varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
             timevar = "subj_group",
             v.names = "active_contr",
             times = c("1","2","3"), 
             direction = "long")
  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  mild2_final <- merge(mild2_r,mild_activecontr2_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  
  condition <- 'mild'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(mild_2)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(mild_2)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(mild_2)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow(mild2_final))
  mild2_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond,mild2_final)
  
  
  ##threat condition
  
  threat <- wb[ , grepl( "pgg_threat", names( wb ) ) ] 
  threat <- threat[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( threat ) ) ] 
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(threat))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.threat., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  threat_order <- unique(columns_sep$cond)
  
  # threat block 1
  threat_1 <- wb[ , grepl( threat_order[1] , names( wb ) ) ]
  threat1_trials <- as.data.frame(threat_1[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( threat_1 ) )])
  threat1_activecontr <- as.data.frame(threat_1[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names(threat_1 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed topool
  shocks1_trials <- as.data.frame(threat_1[ , grepl( "is_shock_trial" , names( threat_1 ) )])
  # number of trials with shocks within each condition blocks
  rm_threat1 <- as.vector(which(apply(shocks1_trials, 2, function(x) any(grepl(1, x))))) # columns with data to be removed because of the shock receipt

  
  
  #transpose 
  threat_1 <- t(threat1_trials)
  threat_activecontr1 <- t(threat1_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(threat_1) = NULL
  dimnames(threat_activecontr1) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  threat_1 <- as.data.frame(threat_1)
  names(threat_1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  threat_activecontr1 <- as.data.frame(threat_activecontr1)
  names(threat_activecontr1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(threat_1))
  block_nr = 1
  
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(threat_1))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(threat_1))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == threat_order[1]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(threat_1))
  
  
  threat_1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order,block, threat_1)
  threat_activecontr1 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, threat_activecontr1)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  threat1_r <- reshape(data=threat_1, 
                     idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                     varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                     timevar = "subj_group",
                     v.names = "contr",
                     times = c("1","2","3"), 
                     direction = "long")
  
  threat_activecontr1_r <- reshape(data=threat_activecontr1, 
             idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
             varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
             timevar = "subj_group",
             v.names = "active_contr",
             times = c("1","2","3"), 
             direction = "long")
  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  threat1_final <- merge(threat1_r,threat_activecontr1_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  condition <- 'threat'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(threat_1)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(threat_1)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(threat_1)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow( threat1_final))
  threat1_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond, threat1_final)
  
  
  
  # threat block 2
  threat_2 <- wb[ , grepl( threat_order[2] , names( wb ) ) ]
  threat2_trials <- as.data.frame(threat_2[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( threat_2 ) )])
  shocks2_trials <- as.data.frame(threat_2[ , grepl( "is_shock_trial" , names( threat_2 ) )])
  threat2_activecontr <- as.data.frame(threat_2[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names(threat_2) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed topool
  # number of trials with shocks within each condition blocks
  rm_threat2 <- as.vector(which(apply(shocks2_trials, 2, function(x) any(grepl(1, x))))) # columns with data to be removed because of the shock receipt

  
  #transpose 
  threat_2 <- t(threat2_trials)
  threat_activecontr2 <- t(threat2_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(threat_2) = NULL
  dimnames(threat_activecontr2) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  threat_2 <- as.data.frame(threat_2)
  names(threat_2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  threat_activecontr2 <- as.data.frame(threat_activecontr2)
  names(threat_activecontr2)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  
  trial_nr = c(1:nrow(threat_2))
  block_nr = 2
  
  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(threat_2))
  block <- rep.int(block_nr,nrow(threat_2))
  order_nr <- which(sequence_task$sequence_task == threat_order[2]) #order of a condition in a sequence task 
  order <- rep.int(order_nr,nrow(threat_2))
  
  
  threat_2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, threat_2)
  threat_activecontr2 <- cbind(group, trial_nr, order, block, threat_activecontr2)
  
  # change from wide to long format 
  threat2_r <- reshape(data=threat_2, 
                       idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
                       varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
                       timevar = "subj_group",
                       v.names = "contr",
                       times = c("1","2","3"), 
                       direction = "long")
  
    
  threat_activecontr2_r <- reshape(data=threat_activecontr2, 
             idvar=c('group','trial_nr','block','order'),
             varying=list(c(5,6,7)), 
             timevar = "subj_group",
             v.names = "active_contr",
             times = c("1","2","3"), 
             direction = "long")
  
  #merge information about contribution with information about whether it was an active contribution
  threat2_final <- merge(threat2_r,threat_activecontr2_r,by=c("subj_group","trial_nr","group","order","block"))
  
  
  condition <- 'threat'
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,nrow(threat_2)),rep.int(N+2,nrow(threat_2)),rep.int(N+3,nrow(threat_2)))
  threat_cond <- rep.int(condition,nrow(threat2_final))
  threat2_final <- cbind(subj_nr,threat_cond,threat2_final)
  
  
  # assemble all conditions:
  beh <- rbind(safe1_final, safe2_final, threat1_final, threat2_final, mild1_final, mild2_final)
  
  
  # append file 
  out.file <- rbind(out.file, beh)
  N=N+3

} #close loop

# write file to csv document
write.table(out.file, file = "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Analysis/behavior/beh_ppg_shocks.csv",sep=";", 
            row.names = FALSE, qmethod = "double",fileEncoding="windows-1252")
```

Extract individual contributions from each participant and save it as csv file - without shock trials 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

getwd()
setwd("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv")
path <- "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv/"

out.file<-""
file.names <- dir(path, pattern =".csv")
N <- 0 #subject number

for(i in 1:length(file.names)){
  file <- read.table(file.names[i],header=TRUE, sep=";", stringsAsFactors=FALSE) #should be "i" instead of 1
  print(file.names[i])
  print(i)
  
  
  # calculate subject number - absolute 
  subj_nr = c(rep.int(N+1,10),rep.int(N+2,10),rep.int(N+3,10))


  # load data for public goods game
  wb <- read.csv(file = file.names[i],sep=";")#[,224:1207]#should be "i" instead of 1 

  ## extract the order of conditions 
  sequence <- wb[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( wb ) ) ] 
  cols <- data.frame(colnames(sequence))
  cols_sep <- cols %>% separate(colnames.sequence., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  sequence_task <- unique(cols_sep$cond)
  sequence_task <- as.data.frame(sequence_task)
  sequence_task$order <- c(1:nrow(sequence_task))

  ## extract individual contributions to the public pools 
  #safe condition
  safe <- wb[ , grepl( "pgg_safe", names( wb ) ) ] 
  safe <- safe[ , grepl( "player.contribution", names( safe ) ) ] 
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(safe))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.safe., c("cond","rest"), sep = "([.])")
  # order of the trials, in order to know which condition was presented first 
  safe_order <- unique(columns_sep$cond)

  # safe block 1
  safe_1 <- wb[ , grepl( safe_order[1] , names( wb ) ) ] #find columns for safe condition block 1
  safe1_trials <- as.data.frame(safe_1[ , grepl( "player.contribution" , names( safe_1 ) )]) #extract total contributions to the pool for each round 
  safe1_activecontr <- as.data.frame(safe_1[ , grepl( "player.is_contributed" , names( safe_1 ) )]) #extract information on whether a pp actively contributed to the pool
  #transpose 
  safe_1 <- t(safe1_trials)
  safe_activecontr1 <- t(safe1_activecontr)
  #remove rownames
  dimnames(safe_1) = NULL
  dimnames(safe_activecontr1) = NULL
  #name column with contributions
  safe_1 <- as.data.frame(safe_1)
  names(safe_1)[1:3] <- c('P1','P2','P3')
  trial_nr = c(1:10)
  block_nr = 1
  
  safe_activecontr1 <- as.data.frame(safe_activecontr1)

  }
  
  
  # remove trials with mild stimulation and shocks 
  threat2_trials <- threat2_trials[-c(rm_threat2)] #select(threat2_trials, -all_of(rm_threat2))
  threat2_activecontr <- threat2_activecontr[-c(rm_threat2)] #select(threat2_activecontr, -all_of(rm_threat2))
  
  #subj 16: add NA row to threat1_trials and threat2_trials: 3 shock trials removed, leaving 9 trials, which creates a problem for assembling later 
  if (length(threat2_trials) == 9){
    threat2_trials$pgg_threat_append.group.player.contribution = c(NA,NA,NA)
    threat2_activecontr$pgg_threat_append.group.player.contribution = c(NA,NA,NA)
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:nrow(beh_data)){
```

Create lagged time variables for each block and condition: individual responses
```{r}

## sepearet data based on threat condition and block number 
beh_threat_bl1 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "1" & threat_cond == "threat"))
beh_threat_bl2 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "2" & threat_cond == "threat"))

beh_mild_bl1 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "1" & threat_cond == "mild"))
beh_mild_bl2 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "2" & threat_cond == "mild"))

beh_safe_bl1 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "1" & threat_cond == "safe"))
beh_safe_bl2 <- droplevels(subset(beh_data, block == "2" & threat_cond == "safe"))


## create lagged variables 

#lagging threat block 1 trials
beh_threat_bl1 <- slide(data = beh_threat_bl1, Var = 'contr', GroupVar = c("subj_nr"),
                NewVar = 'contr_1', slideBy = -1)
beh_threat_bl1 <- slide(data = beh_threat_bl1, Var = 'contr', GroupVar = c("subj_nr"),
                 NewVar = 'contr_2', slideBy = -2)
beh_threat_bl1 <- slide(data = beh_threat_bl1, Var = 'contr', GroupVar = c("subj_nr"),
                 NewVar = 'contr_3', slideBy = -3)
# beh_threat_bl1 <- slide(data = beh_threat_bl1, Var = 'contr', GroupVar = c("subj_nr"),
```

## SVO
Extract SVO 
```{r, echo=FALSE}


path <- ("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv")

file.names <- dir(path, pattern =".csv")


N <- 0 #subject number
out.svo <-""
for(i in 1:length(file.names)){

  setwd("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv")
  
  #group number  
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  

  # load data for SVO
  wb <- read.csv(file = file.names[i],sep=";")#[,224:1207]#should be "i" instead of 1 

  svo <- wb[ , grepl( "svo", names( wb ) ) ] 
  # svo_angle, alpha, svo_type, inequality aversion score
  final_svo <- as.data.frame(svo[ ,c(1,49:52)])
  
  
  #name column with contributions
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(final_svo))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.final_svo., c("rest1","rest2",'rest3','quest'), sep = "([.])")
  names(final_svo)[1:5] <- columns_sep$quest

  #group number
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(final_svo))
  
  final_svo <- as.data.frame(final_svo[ ,c(1:5)])

  temp_svo <- cbind(group, final_svo)

  # append file 
  out.svo <- rbind(out.svo, temp_svo)
  N=N+3

} 


#remove rows with empty cells or with NA 
# empty cells -> NA
out.svo_file[out.svo_file==""] <- NA

#remove rows with all columns containing NA
out.svo_file <- out.svo_file[rowSums(is.na(out.svo_file)) != ncol(out.svo_file), ]


# write file to csv document
write.table(out.svo, file = "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Analysis/behavior/svo.csv",sep=";", 
           row.names = FALSE, qmethod = "double",fileEncoding="windows-1252")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#load data

# 1: Individualistic
# 2: Prosocial
# 3: Competitive
for(i in 1:nrow(beh)){
  if (beh$svo_type[i] == "Individualist") {
    beh$svoType_num[i] = 1
    } else if (beh$svo_type[i] == "Prosocial") {
      beh$svoType_num[i] = 2
    } else if (beh$svo_type[i] == "Competitive") {
      beh$svoType_num[i] = 2
    }
}
```

# free -riding
```{r}
for(i in 1:nrow(beh)) {
    if (beh$contr[i] == 0 & !is.na(beh$contr[i])) {
        beh$freer[i] = 1 
     } else if (beh$contr[i] > 0 & !is.na(beh$contr[i])) {
       beh$freer[i] = 0 
     } else if (is.na(beh$contr[i]) ||  beh$contr[i] == '') {
       beh$freer[i] = NA
     }
}
```

```{r}
# set the working directory
getwd()

#rename columns to match with behavioral dataframe

SCRdat$group <- as.factor(SCRdat$group)
SCRdat$trial_nr <- as.numeric(SCRdat$trial_nr)
SCRdat$block <- as.factor(SCRdat$block)

for (i in 1:nrow(SCRdat)) {
  if (SCRdat$trial_nr2[i] <= 10) {
    SCRdat$trial_nr[i] <- SCRdat$trial_nr2[i]

      SCRdat$trial_nr[i] <- SCRdat$trial_nr2[i]-10
    }
}

#merge with behavioral data
```

## Questionnaires 
Extract final questionnaires: demographics, empathy and exit questionnaire 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
getwd()
setwd("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv")
path <- "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Data/behavior/beh_csv/"

out.file<-""
out_empathy.file<-""
out_demog.file<-""

file.names <- dir(path, pattern =".csv")
N <- 0 #subject number

for(i in 1:length(file.names)){
  file <- read.table(file.names[i],header=TRUE, sep=";", stringsAsFactors=FALSE) #should be "i" instead of 1
  print(file.names[i])
  print(i)
  
  
  # calculate subject number - absolute 
  subj_nr = c(N+1,N+2,N+3)
  group_nr <- unlist(regmatches(file.names[i], gregexpr('\\(?[0-9,.]+', file.names[i])))
  group_nr <- as.numeric(gsub('\\(', '-', gsub(',', '', group_nr)))
  

  # load data for public goods game
  wb <- read.csv(file = file.names[i],sep=";")#[,224:1207]#should be "i" instead of 1 

  exit_quest <- wb[ , grepl( "exit_quest", names( wb ) ) ] 
  
  if (group_nr < 17) {
    final_quest <- as.data.frame(exit_quest[, c(1,25:31)])
    final_quest[,c(9:12)] <- NA
  } else {
    final_quest <- as.data.frame(exit_quest[ ,c(1,25:35)])
  }
  
  #name column with contributions
  #final_quest <- as.data.frame(final_quest)
  columns <- data.frame(colnames(final_quest))
  columns_sep <- columns %>% separate(colnames.final_quest., c("rest1","rest2",'rest3','quest'), sep = "([.])")
  if (group_nr < 17) {
    names(final_quest)[1:8] <- columns_sep$quest
    names(final_quest)[9:12] <- c('motivation','prior_experience','prior_knowledge','knowing_eachother')
    
  } else {
    names(final_quest)[1:12] <- columns_sep$quest
  }
  
  #group number
  group <- rep.int(group_nr,nrow(final_quest))
  
  empathy_quest <- as.data.frame(exit_quest[ ,c(1, 2:21)])
  demog <- as.data.frame(exit_quest[ , c(1, 22:24)])
  
  temp_quest <- cbind(subj_nr,group, final_quest)
  temp_empathy <- cbind(subj_nr,group, empathy_quest)
  temp_demog <- cbind(subj_nr,group, demog)

  # append file 
  out.file <- rbind(out.file, temp_quest)
  out_empathy.file <- rbind(out_empathy.file, temp_empathy)
  out_demog.file <- rbind(out_demog.file, temp_demog)
  N=N+3
  

} 

```

Add the questionnaire output to the final output file
```{r,echo=FALSE}

#uplaod the data
getwd()
setwd("P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Analysis/behavior") 
path <- "P:/Postdoc/PGD_threat/Analysis/behavior"

demog <- read.csv("demog.csv" , sep = ';')
demog <- subset(demog, select=-c(exit_quest.1.player.id_in_group))
names(demog)[names(demog) == "exit_quest.1.player.sex"] <- "gender"
names(demog)[names(demog) == "exit_quest.1.player.age"] <- "age"
names(demog)[names(demog) == "exit_quest.1.player.field_study"] <- "field_study"

empathy <- read.csv("empathy_q.csv" , sep = ';')
empathy <- subset(empathy, select=-c(exit_quest.1.player.id_in_group))


final_quests <- read.csv("quest.csv" , sep = ';')
final_quests <- subset(final_quests, select=-c(id_in_group))



#calculate empathic concern score from the empathic concern scale (Batson 1997)
# following items: sympathetic, softhearted, warm, compassionate, tender, moved 
empathy$empathic_concern_score <- rowMeans(subset(empathy, select = c(exit_quest.1.player.sympathetic_3, exit_quest.1.player.softhearted_5,
                                                                      exit_quest.1.player.warm_7, exit_quest.1.player.compassionate_12, 
                                                                      exit_quest.1.player.tender_15, exit_quest.1.player.moved_17)), na.rm=T)


#calculate emotional distress score from the emotional distress scale (Batson 1997)
#items 11 should be perturbed and 'confident' was used - do not include this item in the calculation
empathy$emotional_distress_score <- rowMeans(subset(empathy, select = c(exit_quest.1.player.alarmed_1,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.grieved_2,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.intrigued_4,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.troubled_6,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.heavy_hearted_8,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.distressed_9,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.low_spirited_10,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.upset_13,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.disturbed_14,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.worried_16,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.sorrowful_18,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.feeling_low_19,
                                                                        exit_quest.1.player.uneasy_20)), na.rm = T)




temp <- merge(demog,empathy, by = c('subj_nr', 'group'), all=T)
temp <- merge(temp,final_quests, by = c('subj_nr', 'group'), all=T)

#merge with behavioral data
beh <- as.data.frame(merge(beh, temp, by=c('subj_nr','group'), all=T))
```
